_about: Overrides for the Guides import from the community Google Sheet. `_tabs` maps a sheet tab whose name is not a character's name to that character's res_id. `_pictures` labels a sheet picture the importer could not identify, keyed by the hash the review page shows (client_db/.cache/guides/unidentified.html): {"charResId": 1003}, {"cardId": "c_1003_uni1"} or {"skip": true}. One label covers every use of that picture on every tab. A single cell can also be labelled with an entry keyed "<tab>!<cell>", such as "Tenebria!B11", plus a `_why`. `{"skip": true}` on a cell leaves out its text and pictures.
